intended_object: The standard Frobenius endomorphism F_p of the rank-two symplectic group Sp₄(F̄_p), which raises every matrix entry to the p-th power, where p is the defining characteristic. Here Sp₄(F̄_p) is the library's ambient group for an index on the B₂ diagram, and the description comes from the docstring.
explanation:
The body is `SpStd.frobenius 1 p 1 Closure`. That is the library's p^k-power Frobenius on the points of the type-C_(n+1) carrier, taken at n = 1 and k = 1. It is defined as the map on points induced by the ring endomorphism `iterateFrobenius A p 1`, which is x ↦ x^p, so it raises every matrix entry to the p-th power. The companion lemma `coe_primeFrobenius_apply` states exactly this. The field `Closure` is the algebraic closure of the prime field and has exponential characteristic p, so the map is a well-defined group endomorphism of Sp₄(F̄_p).

This is a specific endomorphism of a specific group: the prime Frobenius attached to this index. It specializes the library's own general carrier Frobenius, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no Frobenius endomorphism of symplectic groups that could serve as a counterpart. The docstring's other claims are also consistent with the code:
- the map agrees with the q-power `frobenius` exactly when the field exponent is 1;
- the half-Frobenius of a Suzuki index squares to this map.
